game.title: Star Wars: Squadrons
game.blurb: Starfighter combat game with a story campaign and online battles, from Motive Studios (published by Electronic Arts), released 2020-10-02. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Simulation. Story chapters follow the StrategyWiki walkthrough sections; the rest are drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Prologues and the First Missions
chapters.summary: The two prologues (one for each side) and the first four missions: Form the Vanguard, The Skies of Yavin, Through Enemy Lines and Secrets and Spies.

chapters.title: The Middle Missions
chapters.summary: The Trail from Desevro, Signal to Noise, Into the Abyss, Fractured Alliance and Chaos at Mon Cala.

chapters.title: The Final Missions
chapters.summary: Terisa's Vengeance, Nowhere to Stand, Rally the New Republic, Fire in the Heart and Last Flight of the Starhawk. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hidden Story Milestones
chapters.summary: Nine achievements Steam keeps secret, most likely earned along the campaign. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Story Medals
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on Story Mode, Pilot, Veteran and Ace, and earning every Medal in the missions.

chapters.title: Hangar, Loadouts and Pilot Level
chapters.summary: Starfighter components, Legendary cosmetics, changing a loadout, Awards and pilot levels 10 and 40.

chapters.title: Dogfight
chapters.summary: Winning Dogfight matches, destroying every starfighter class and the 50, 250 and 1000 kill counts.

chapters.title: Fleet Battles
chapters.summary: Ranked placement, Ranked and Co-op Fleet Battles, bombing Capital Ships and finishing off a flagship.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Disabling enemies, subsystems, near-death escapes, dodging lock-ons, Seeker Mines and playing in a party.

Fandom (starwars.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars:_Squadrons
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) has the guide under "Star Wars: Squadrons" at completion stage 5, with 42 existing subpages. Its Walkthrough page and all 16 mission pages it lists (two prologues, then fourteen missions from "Form the Vanguard" to "Last Flight of the Starhawk") are written, about 4,400 to 10,600 characters each; so are the ten starfighter pages, Fleet Battles, Components, Ranking, the cosmetics pages and "Achievements and trophies". The three story chapters group the missions in contents order; titles are reworded and no text was copied. starwars.fandom.com answers the API under "Star Wars: Squadrons" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Maverick" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1222730. 9 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden and have their own chapter, so the mission chapters hold no achievements. Some hidden names mention places (for example "Flames Over Mon Cala" and "Fracture at Fostar Haven") that may match missions, but they were not matched to missions. Steam API names run Ach001 to Ach047; Ach008 to Ach011 are listed last in the schema. "Combat feats" achievements do not say which mode they need. RAWG's playtime of 3 hours looks low.
